text_block_list.text:
On this day, rookie and veteran trainers gathered
for a meeting to present their training results.
It was a highly educational session, but—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
At the next Trainer Regular Report Meeting, it will finally be
<username> Trainer's turn to present...!
I am really looking forward to the big day!
choice_data_list: (I have to make it a total success!)

text_block_list.text:
And so, fired up for the presentation,
I set to work, but—

A few days later... Although I was preparing for the presentation,
I couldn't come up with insightful training theories like the veterans did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um! Are you alright?
Excuse me, but you looked like you had something heavy on your mind...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see...! You're anxious about whether
your presentation will go well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In that case! I have a recommended method
that'll blow those worries right away!
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Muscle training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's start off with some dumbbell lifts for now!
Alright, try holding this 20kg one!

I wasn't sure muscle training had anything to do with it, but she was
genuinely trying to help in her own way.
I want to respond to her kindness with everything I've got...!
Fired up with resolve, I attempted to lift it, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!
Looks like that was way too heavy.
choice_data_list: Looks like I can't do it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! From what I can see, Trainer,
your deltoids still have tons of room for growth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's swap to 5kg and try once more!
Believe in your deltoids!

Encouraged by her words, I spent that whole day
diligent on 5kg dumbbell training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Today, let's try 10kg!
Listen, can't you hear your biceps saying they've got this?
choice_data_list: I might... kind of feel it?

text_block_list.text:
Keeping up the pace,
I gradually increased the weight day by day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your pecs are in great shape too!
Today is finally 20kg day!
You managed 15kg, so have confidence!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I feel like I can do it...!
Mm, feels like I can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right! That's the spirit!
Now, lift it up!

And then... the 20kg dumbbell that didn't budge an inch before
floated slightly into the air...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you did!
You really pulled it off, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As long as you build it up step by step,
there's nothing you can't achieve!

Hearing her say that, a thought suddenly struck me.
If so, then by building up the report presentation step by step as well... perhaps...
choice_data_list: I'll take it steady and work on the presentation step by step, without rushing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...!
Hehehe, you beat me to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If you advance step by step, nothing is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As you've realized, the reason I invited you to workout
was because I wanted you to experience that firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good luck with your presentation!
I'll be cheering you on!
